features.configuration: Default cwd/config.json; --config PATH or --no-config; built-in defaults < JSON < CLI. Relative JSON paths use configuration directory. Host settings, attention and runtime native mounts persist through atomic replacement and per-path process locking. strict-host remains CLI-only.
features.frozenNamespace: Visible frozen entries with snowflake/dashed outline/badge; every config.json and active basename at any depth reserved. Physical identity blocks renamed hardlinks/native mounts; linked retired generations remain protected after atomic saves and restarts (1024 identities maximum). All read/write/preview/Range/MCP/P2P operations denied, recursive frontend workflows skip entries, ancestor mutations preflight. Identity probes use attributes/stat only, followed by an opened-file identity guard; no body reads to identify frozen aliases.
features.mountedPCDN: Dedicated mount source-version namespace, no full-upload prerequisite for P2P ticket/join. Proven mount owner preferred as direct 1MiB source; up to4 active source assignments, aggregate page bandwidth/cache and2 sends. Authenticated source manifests until complete host replica exists. Path+version hash isolation and4-task coalescing. Slow host replication and demand-priority durable materialization remain.
features.requestBudgets: Provider poll/reply/payload use separate32-control slots; replica uploads separate8 slots. Deferred bounded JSON stays control-owned; file body transfers use ordinary transfer budget. Tested with max-transfers1.
